what: Baseline prefill speed measurement with both levers 1+2 ON (b12x gate + in_proj_ba transpose)
profile: C1, MTP-3, graph decode, fp8 KV, 180k context, max-num-seqs=8, max-num-batched-tokens=8192
method: 5 HTTP requests with max_tokens=1, prompts 50-2801 tokens. Engine metrics: request_prefill_time_seconds_sum / prompt_tokens_total

result.note: This is the BASELINE prefill rate. The 6000 tok/s target is for lever 3 (fused kernel) which is infeasible (stop condition #3). The existing prefill path uses reconstruct+cuBLAS for M>144 which is already near-optimal. The ~1451 tok/s engine rate (vs docs/36's 3374 tok/s at 2048 tokens) reflects HTTP overhead and shorter average prompt lengths in this test.

docs_reference: docs/36-performance-levers-5090.md measured 3374 tok/s at 2048 prompt tokens, 3255 at 6144 tokens
